worldOverview.name: Veilwood
worldOverview.description: Lost in a drowned forest where daylight never lands. Forage glowing mushrooms that mend or poison, slip past the two hunters of the dark, and climb east to the one place the canopy breaks.
worldOverview.author: Formamorph
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
The player is lost in the Veilwood, a drowned forest where the canopy shuts out the sky and the fog never lifts. They wandered in by {{ph:250c56c8-b570-4030-8a9c-398d5b189491:world:1be4e1c1-bb84-4622-b1d1-a95f56e29491}}, and the wood has turned them in circles since. The way out is the Veilbreak, a ridge east of the Hollow Fig where real daylight reaches the ground.

Tone: eerie, hushed and beautiful. Dread comes from sound, stillness and shadow. Wounds stay survivable, and the wood shows its beauty as often as its danger.

You are the narrator of this wood. Your job is to keep the journey moving:
- Build each scene from the features its area's description names: roots, black water, fog and fungus light. Give the player one of them to use, cross or hide behind.
- Each mushroom has fixed effects. When the player eats one, apply the effects written on that mushroom.
- Predator Attention says how close the hunters are. Show it through the wood's sounds, as its current level describes. At Hunted, a hunter arrives.
- Each hunter has one weakness, and the wood hints at it. The Shadow Raptor cannot climb. The Dread Crawler is blind and finds prey by sound. Both are animals: they hunt, give up and move on.
- The lantern moths scatter before a hunter comes and drift east at dusk. They are the player's alarm and compass.
- When the player crosses the Veilbreak into open sun, narrate a triumphant finale: real daylight, birdsong, and the fog behind them.
- Each turn puts one new thing in the player's path: food, a sign of a hunter, or a sign of the way east.
- One strange detail of this wood: {{ph:5aecccba-79cd-471d-bd26-73de1b39e151:world:2d9f5599-5236-4700-9918-998e25e54563}}. Let it surface now and then as a plain fact that nobody explains.
- The creatures of the Veilwood speak only with their bodies and their sounds: splashes, clicks, screams, and the hush they leave behind.
worldOverview.readme:
## Veilwood

You're lost in a forest that eats daylight. Somewhere east, the canopy breaks. Reach **the Veilbreak** and cross into open sun to win.

**Playing**
- **Satiety** falls every turn. The glowing mushrooms are food, and each kind has fixed effects. One of them is poison in pretty colors.
- **Toxin** climbs when you eat the wrong thing and fades slowly. At 75% or more, **Veil Sight** switches on, and you start seeing things that aren't there.
- **Stamina** pays for running, climbing and wading. **Stress** climbs in the dark and falls when you find calm.
- **The Veil's Hold** is always on. Every path but east bends back, and the hunters close in a little each turn.
- Two hunters rule the wood, and each has a weakness. Watch the wood for hints.
- Switch on **Move Quietly** from your traits at any time. You're much harder to track, but slow and tiring. Panic breaks it: it switches off while Stress is at 75% or more.
- Watch the lantern moths. They know things.

## How this world is built

Open this world in the World Editor with Advanced mode on, then select **The Wanderer** entity.

- **Automatic trait.** **The Veil's Hold** in the **Curse** group has no requirements, so it's always on. It carries the curse's rule for the AI and the hunters' rising Predator Attention.
- **Trait gates.** **Veil Sight** is Automatic and requires Toxin at 75% or more, so it comes and goes with the poison. **Move Quietly** requires Stress below 75%.
- **Pick counts.** **Constitution** and **Temperament** take exactly one pick each. **Instincts** takes any number.
- **Opening weights.** The world has four openings. The rarest one draws about one game in nine.
- **Player toggle.** **Move Quietly** is a trait you switch on and off in play.
- **Hidden stat.** **Predator Attention** stays off your stat bar. The AI reads it to pace the hunters.
- **Rolled placeholders.** How you got lost, the surveyor's name and one strange detail each roll once per playthrough.
- **Lorebook.** **The Veilwood Field Notes** dictionary holds the fungi, the hunters and the way out.
worldOverview.introReadme:
🌫️ **The trail behind you is gone.** The Veilwood has you now: a drowned forest where the canopy swallows daylight and the only lights are fog and fungus.

Pick one **Constitution**, one **Temperament**, and any **Instincts** you like:

- **Constitution** sets what your body can take. **Iron Constitution** shrugs off wounds, **Endurance Athlete** runs longest but eats fast, and **Survivalist** needs less food and clears poison sooner.
- **Temperament** sets how fear sits with you. **Zen Master** stays calm, **Adrenaline Junkie** has deep reserves but never settles, and **Stress Eater** calms down fast at the cost of food.
- **Instincts** are extras: a gut for poison, room for a big meal, or an eye for danger before it sees you.

You don't pick the last one. **The Veil's Hold** is the wood's curse, and it's always on: every path but east bends back, and the hunters always learn you're here.

Each playthrough rolls how you got lost, whose camp waits ahead, and one strange detail the wood won't explain.

Somewhere east, the canopy breaks.

openings.text: I stop and turn a full circle. The trail is gone. Root arches and black water stand in every direction, and there's no sky, only a ceiling of leaves lit dim green. Far off between the trunks, one thin line of real daylight.
I wake against a root arch with fog on my face and cold water in my boots. Above me, a string of lantern moths hangs perfectly still in the air. Every one of them faces the same way.

A scream tears through the thicket behind you, high and furious, and then the wood goes quiet. The frogs stop. Along the roots, the mushroom glow seems to dim.

You stand shin-deep in the Drowned Hollow with nothing above you but a ceiling of leaves. Somewhere in the undergrowth, something large moves slowly, the way a hunter moves while it is still searching.

You find the footprints at the edge of the hollow: one set, pressed fresh into the mud, heading into the trees. You set your boot beside one. It fits exactly.

You have walked this way before, and the wood turned you back. Above the far trunks, one thin line of daylight still burns in the east.

stats.name: Predator Attention
stats.description: How aware the wood's hunters are of the player. Raise it when the player is loud, fast or bleeding. Lower it when they hide, wade or hold still.

descriptors.description: Unnoticed. The wood's sounds are ordinary, and nothing tracks the player.
Watched. Something has the player's scent. Distant splashes and snapped twigs keep pace with them.
Stalked. A hunter is close. The moths scatter, the frogs go silent, and something moves in the fog.
Hunted. A hunter is upon the player, and an encounter begins now.

locations.name: The Veilwood
locations.playerDescription: A drowned forest under a closed canopy. The only lights are fog-glow and fungus; the only sounds are water and things you cannot see.
locations.aiDescription: The Veilwood: a drowned forest under a closed canopy of towering trees and vines. Humid air, black water, creeping roots and glowing fungus keep it in a constant twilight. Its foraging grounds, waterways and hunters lie in the areas below, and the way out lies east.
locations.aiSummary: The Veilwood: the drowned twilight forest the player must escape.
locations.imageTags: drowned forest, towering trees, closed canopy, black water, fog, bioluminescent fungus, twilight

locations.name: The Drowned Hollow
locations.playerDescription: A sunken clearing of root arches and shin-deep water. Whatever path brought you here, it doesn't lead back out.
locations.aiDescription: The Drowned Hollow, where the player first realized they were lost: a flooded clearing ringed by root arches and shin-deep black water. Ember Speckles, black-and-orange caps on orange stems, glow along the roots. The water drains east into the Blackwater Channels, and things from the channels come up it. Paths lead deeper into the wood, and none lead back.
locations.imageTags: flooded forest clearing, root arches, black water, glowing orange mushrooms, fog, twilight

locations.name: Gloomcap Thicket
locations.playerDescription: Undergrowth so dense it has its own weather. Most of the wood's glow — and most of its mushrooms — grows here.
locations.aiDescription: Gloomcap Thicket: dense undergrowth rich in glowing fungus. It has the wood's best foraging and its worst sightlines. The Shadow Raptor hunts these lanes, and the climbable trees are the one refuge it cannot follow into.
locations.imageTags: dense dark undergrowth, bioluminescent mushrooms, blue and orange glow, narrow forest lanes, fog

locations.name: Blackwater Channels
locations.playerDescription: Slow, cold waterways braided through the trees. Wading is miserable — and quiet.
locations.aiDescription: The Blackwater Channels: cold, sluggish waterways braided through the trees. Wading strips scent and muffles sound at the cost of stamina and nerve. The blind Dread Crawler swims here, hunting by sound.
locations.imageTags: dark swamp waterways, still black water, half-submerged roots, mist, faint blue glow

locations.name: The Hollow Fig
locations.playerDescription: A tree the size of a chapel, hollow at heart, with room to climb high and stay dry. Someone camped here once.
locations.aiDescription: The Hollow Fig: a colossal hollow tree with dry chambers and perches above any leap the Shadow Raptor can make. The Dread Crawler can climb it. A surveyor's abandoned camp sits in its heart.
locations.imageTags: giant hollow tree interior, abandoned campsite, canvas shelter, rope, dim green light

locations.name: The Surveyor's Camp
locations.playerDescription: A collapsed canvas shelter inside the Hollow Fig: ration tins, a waterproof journal, and a hand-drawn map missing its other half.
locations.aiDescription: The surveyor's camp inside the Hollow Fig, left behind by {{ph:12382226-bdc4-45aa-a9a4-1089bec1c173:world:94ecb21a-d775-423f-98de-00bbedc5a529}}: a collapsed canvas shelter, ration tins that are safe food, and the surveyor's journal with its map fragment.
locations.aiSummary: Surveyor's camp: an abandoned shelter with safe ration tins and the surveyor's journal.
locations.imageTags: abandoned campsite inside hollow tree, canvas tarp, tin cans, weathered journal, hand-drawn map

locations.name: The Veilbreak
locations.playerDescription: East of everything: a ridge where the canopy fails and a blade of real daylight cuts to the ground.
locations.aiDescription: The Veilbreak: a rocky rise east of the Hollow Fig where the canopy tears open and real daylight reaches the ground. The last approach is a hard, exposed climb. Crossing into the open sun beyond it ends the ordeal.
locations.imageTags: forest edge, ray of sunlight through canopy break, rocky ridge, mist parting

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.playerDescription: You are lost in the Veilwood, with the trail gone and the canopy blocking the sky.
entities.aiDescription: {{char}} is lost in the Veilwood, a drowned forest where the canopy swallows daylight and the fog never lifts.
entities.aiSummary: A traveler lost in a drowned forest.

traits.name: Iron Constitution
traits.playerDescription: Hard to hurt, quick to mend.
traits.aiDescription: The player is remarkably resilient. They withstand more damage and recover from wounds faster than most.

traits.name: Endurance Athlete
traits.playerDescription: Built for the long haul, but the engine wants fuel.
traits.aiDescription: The player can sustain hard physical effort for a long time, at the cost of a fast metabolism that burns through food.

traits.name: Survivalist
traits.aiDescription: The player is adapted to harsh conditions. They need less food than most and shake off poisons faster.

traits.name: Zen Master
traits.playerDescription: The dark is just the dark.
traits.aiDescription: The player stays calm under pressure. Fear passes through them and drains away quickly.

traits.name: Adrenaline Junkie
traits.playerDescription: Fear is fuel. It just never quite switches off.
traits.aiDescription: The player thrives on danger. They have deeper energy reserves and recover faster, but their nerves never fully settle.

traits.name: Stress Eater
traits.aiDescription: Eating soothes the player. Their fear fades fast, but their appetite runs ahead of their supplies.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.playerDescription: A gut that argues with poison, and usually wins.
traits.aiDescription: The player tolerates toxins far better than most and purges them faster.

traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: You can eat big when the chance comes, and it carries you farther.
traits.aiDescription: The player can eat large amounts when food is there and draws more from every meal.

traits.name: Keen Eye
traits.playerDescription: You see the wrong color and the too-still shadow before they see you.
traits.aiDescription: The player notices what others miss: a wrong color on a cap, a too-still shadow, a hunter's sign before the hunter. They walk into danger far less often.

traits.name: Move Quietly
traits.playerDescription: Slow, tested steps and shallow breathing. Hard to track, and tiring.
traits.aiDescription: The player moves slowly and carefully, testing each step, breathing shallow and touching nothing. They are very hard to hear or track, but they cover ground slowly, and the strain tires them.

traits.name: The Veil's Hold
traits.playerDescription: Every path but east bends back toward the heart of the wood, and the hunters learn a little more of you each turn.
traits.aiDescription: The wood turns the player in circles. Every path except east bends back toward the Drowned Hollow, and the player keeps finding their own tracks. East, the way the lantern moths drift at dusk, is the one direction that keeps going.

traits.name: Veil Sight
traits.playerDescription: The poison shows you things that aren't there. It passes when Toxin falls below 75%.
traits.aiDescription: The player is badly poisoned and hallucinates. Each turn, weave one false sight or sound into the real wood, built from what the scene already holds, with nothing to mark it as false. The real hunters and the real way east are still among them.

traitGroups.name: Constitution
traitGroups.playerDescription: What your body brings to a bad week.

traitGroups.name: Temperament
traitGroups.playerDescription: How your mind meets the dark.

traitGroups.name: Instincts
traitGroups.playerDescription: Instincts worth having in a place like this.

traitGroups.name: Curse
traitGroups.playerDescription: What the wood does to you. You don't pick these.
traitGroups.aiDescription: The Veilwood's hold on the player:

stats.name: Health
stats.description: How much harm the player's body can take. Lower it for falls, bites and poison. Raise it when a mushroom's effects mend the player.

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely wounded, barely conscious, and at risk of death.
Injured. Suffering from multiple wounds, movement impaired, combat effectiveness reduced.
Hurt. Minor injuries present, some pain, but generally functional.
Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: The player's energy for running, climbing and wading. Lower it for hard effort. Raise it when the player rests or eats a mushroom that restores it.

descriptors.description: Exhausted. Barely able to move, risk of collapse, unable to perform strenuous actions.
Tired. Movements are sluggish, difficulty in sustained physical activities.
Winded. Slightly out of breath, can perform most actions but not at peak efficiency.
Energetic. Full of energy, capable of performing any physical action without hindrance.

stats.name: Stress
stats.description: The player's fear and strain. Raise it for darkness, close calls and hallucinations. Lower it for calm, warmth and small victories.

descriptors.description: Calm. Relaxed and clear-headed, able to make rational decisions easily.
Tense. Feeling pressure, slightly irritable, may have difficulty concentrating.
Anxious. High tension, prone to emotional outbursts, decision-making impaired.
Mental breakdown. Overwhelmed by stress, irrational behavior, risk of panic attacks.

stats.name: Satiety
stats.description: How fed the player is. Eating moves it by that food's effects.

descriptors.description: Starving. Intense hunger pains, weak and dizzy, risk of fainting, decreased cognitive function.
Hungry. Strong desire for food, stomach growling, difficulty concentrating.
Peckish. Slight hunger, starting to think about food.
Satisfied. Full, no desire for food.

stats.name: Toxin
stats.description: Poison in the player's body. Eating moves it by that food's effects.

descriptors.description: Clear. No poison worth naming; senses steady.
Queasy. A metallic taste; colors slightly too bright.
Poisoned. Stomach cramps, cold sweat, sounds arriving late.
Overwhelmed. The wood melts and rearranges, and nothing the player sees or hears can be trusted.

entities.imageTags: lone traveler, muddy hiking clothes, lost in a dark flooded forest, fog, faint fungus glow

entities.name: Ember Speckle
entities.playerDescription: A dark, mottled cap patterned in black and orange like reptile skin, on a bright, slightly scaly orange stem.
entities.aiDescription: The Ember Speckle: a mushroom with a black-and-orange mottled cap and a curved, scaly orange stem. When eaten: Stamina rises a lot, and Satiety falls. Show both in turn: a rush of energy, then a hollow hunger sharper than before.
entities.aiSummary: Ember Speckle: mushroom; restores stamina, deepens hunger.
entities.imageTags: mushroom, black and orange mottled cap, curved orange stem, dark forest floor, faint glow

entities.name: Midnight Shimmer
entities.playerDescription: An almost-black cap speckled with faint blue spots that glow in low light, on a stem dotted the same way.
entities.aiDescription: The Midnight Shimmer: a near-black mushroom speckled with softly glowing blue spots. When eaten: restores Health and Satiety and raises Stress. A feeling of being watched lingers for hours.
entities.aiSummary: Midnight Shimmer: mushroom; restores health and satiety, raises stress.
entities.imageTags: mushroom, black cap with glowing blue speckles, bioluminescent, dark swamp bank

entities.name: Ember Spire
entities.playerDescription: A fiery red, textured cap on a long, thick stem that fades from red to pale gray, marked with dark spots.
entities.aiDescription: The Ember Spire: a mushroom with a fiery red textured cap and a long, thick stem fading to gray. When eaten: fills Satiety completely and does nothing else. Heavy, dense and joyless, like a loaf of wet bread.
entities.aiSummary: Ember Spire: mushroom; fully restores satiety, no other effect.
entities.imageTags: mushroom, fiery red textured cap, tall thick stem fading to gray, dark spots

entities.name: Night Veil
entities.playerDescription: Three dark, velvety caps stacked close, on a thick stem that shades into shimmering blue patterns near the top.
entities.aiDescription: The Night Veil: three velvety near-black caps on a stem patterned in shimmering blue. When eaten: restores Health and Stamina with deep satisfaction, then raises Stress sharply and raises Toxin, bringing vivid hallucinations.
entities.aiSummary: Night Veil: mushroom; restores health and stamina, then stress, toxin and hallucinations.
entities.imageTags: mushroom, three stacked dark velvety caps, shimmering blue patterned stem, eerie

entities.name: Cerulean Vex
entities.playerDescription: Layered vibrant blue caps with delicate dark gills, on a pale purple stem that spirals into deep violet.
entities.aiDescription: The Cerulean Vex: layered vibrant-blue caps over dark gills on a spiraling violet stem. When eaten: raises Toxin sharply, drains Health and Stamina, and raises Stress. It is the most beautiful thing in the wood, and its beauty is the lure.
entities.aiSummary: Cerulean Vex: poisonous mushroom; spikes toxin, drains health and stamina.
entities.imageTags: mushroom, layered vibrant blue caps, dark gills, spiraling violet stem, beautiful and sinister

entities.name: Shadow Raptor
entities.playerDescription: A fast, muscular hunter with dark scaly skin, glowing yellow eyes and a mouth of too many teeth. It has never once looked up.
entities.aiDescription: The Shadow Raptor: a sinewy ground hunter with dark scales, glowing yellow eyes and razor teeth. It is faster than any human over open ground, and its eyes pick out movement at great distance. It cannot climb. Prey above its leap is prey it cannot take: it circles below, screams once, and moves on. It is an animal, dangerous and without malice.
entities.aiSummary: Shadow Raptor: fast ground predator; deadly in the open, cannot climb.
entities.imageTags: dark scaled predator, raptor-like creature, glowing yellow eyes, crouched, swamp forest

entities.name: Dread Crawler
entities.playerDescription: A sleek, long-limbed hunter that swims and climbs equally well. Its head has no eyes, only ears.
entities.aiDescription: The Dread Crawler: a sleek, sinewy hunter that moves fast over land, water and tree trunks alike and strikes from unexpected angles. It is completely blind. Sound and movement are its only senses. A person who holds perfectly still is invisible to it, and it will pass close enough to touch and move on. It is an animal, dangerous and without malice.
entities.aiSummary: Dread Crawler: blind climber-swimmer that hunts by sound; perfect stillness defeats it.
entities.imageTags: eyeless sleek predator, long limbs, climbing creature, dark swamp, menacing

entities.name: Lantern Moths
entities.playerDescription: Palm-sized moths with wings that glow like paper lanterns. They gather, drift, and sometimes vanish all at once.
entities.aiDescription: Lantern moths: palm-sized, softly glowing and harmless. They scatter minutes before a hunter arrives, so an emptying of lights is a warning. At dusk they drift, unhurried, east toward the Veilbreak. They are the wood's living alarm and compass for anyone who watches.
entities.aiSummary: Lantern Moths: glowing moths that scatter before predators and drift toward the Veilbreak at dusk.
entities.imageTags: glowing moths, soft lantern light, swarm in dark forest, pale luminous wings

entities.name: The Surveyor's Journal
entities.playerDescription: A waterproof field journal in a dead surveyor's neat hand, with half of a hand-drawn map tucked in the back.
entities.aiDescription: The surveyor's journal, written by {{ph:12382226-bdc4-45aa-a9a4-1089bec1c173:world:3f8d2c61-7a4e-4b19-9c05-e6a1b7d4f238}}, who charted the Veilwood for a season. The entries are precise and calm. They name the mushrooms by color and effect and note that the raptor never climbs. The map fragment marks the Veilbreak east of the Hollow Fig. The final entry reads: "Moths all went east at dusk. So will I, at first light."
entities.aiSummary: The Surveyor's Journal: field notes on the wood and a map fragment marking the Veilbreak east.
entities.imageTags: weathered waterproof field journal, hand-drawn map fragment, pencil notes, inside a hollow tree

dictionaries.name: The Veilwood Field Notes
dictionaries.description: A lost surveyor's notes on the wood: its fungi, its hunters, and the way out.

entries.name: The Veil
entries.value: The Veilwood's canopy shuts out the sky, and all light comes from fog glow and glowing fungus. The wood is eerie, hushed and beautiful. Dread comes from sound, stillness and shadow. Injuries stay survivable, and a sign of hope always waits somewhere ahead.

entries.name: Foraging
entries.value: Each mushroom's effects are fixed and take hold within moments of eating. Apply the effects written on the mushroom the player eats. An unfamiliar fungus is a gamble, so describe its taste and texture vividly. Nothing in the wood is dry enough to burn, so the player eats everything raw.

entries.name: The Raptor's Flaw
entries.value: The Shadow Raptor cannot climb. Prey above its leap is prey it cannot take: it circles below, screams once in frustration, and moves on. On open ground, nothing outruns it.

entries.name: The Crawler's Flaw
entries.value: The Dread Crawler is blind, and sound and movement are its only senses. It swims and climbs. A person who holds perfectly still is invisible to it, and it will pass close enough to touch.

entries.name: Blackwater
entries.value: Wading the channels strips scent and muffles sound, so pursuit falls away behind water. The cold saps stamina, and the unseen things brushing past the player's legs fray their nerves.

entries.name: Lantern Moths
entries.value: Lantern moths scatter minutes before a hunter arrives, so an emptying of lights is a warning. At dusk they drift, unhurried, east toward the Veilbreak.

entries.name: The Veilbreak
entries.value: The Veilbreak is the one place the canopy fails. When the player crosses it into open daylight, the ordeal ends: narrate a triumphant finale with real sun, real birdsong, and the fog left behind.

entries.name: The Surveyor
entries.value: The camp in the Hollow Fig belonged to {{ph:12382226-bdc4-45aa-a9a4-1089bec1c173:world:9506ebe4-50b7-40da-9270-3b4cfda853ce}}, who charted the wood for a season. The ration tins there are safe food: they restore Satiety with no risk. The journal and its map fragment point east of the great fig, to the Veilbreak.

values.text: a shortcut that left the marked trail
an old logging road that dead-ended
a dog that slipped its leash
a foraging trip that went one ridge too far
the fog smells faintly of cloves
all birdsong stops at the same moment each day
reflections in the black water lag a half-second behind
distant lights blink in pairs, like eyes
